title: Daily panel parity receipt (data_collection/panel/{trading_day}/parity.json, data_daily_panel_parity.v1)
description: One same-trading-day comparison of the PUBLISHED daily panel against the panel the consumer compiled directly from ArcticDB for the same session (alpha-engine-config-I10791 / P-25, the 'real-day consumer parity' step before the reader switch). Computed by contracts/daily_panel.py::compare_panels, the one definition of 'equivalent within declared tolerance': the comparison covers the consumer's own (trading_day, ticker) rows, so a row the consumer read that the published panel lacks, or a published row inside the consumer's ticker set and window that the consumer did not read, is a mismatch, never skipped. The tolerance used is recorded in the receipt and must equal contracts/daily_panel.py::PARITY_TOLERANCE; a receipt computed under any other tolerance does not count. Read by data_gate/panel.py for the `data.phase3.daily_panel_adopted` clause. PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_daily_panel_contract.py.

verdict.description: equivalent only when rows_compared > 0 and missing_in_producer, missing_in_consumer and value_mismatches are all 0.

examples.description: Up to 20 named differences, so a divergent verdict says WHERE without reading either panel.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the comparison ran. Provenance.

key.description: Where the compared panel was read from (bucket-relative key or store URI).

trading_day.description: The session that side's panel ends on. Must equal the receipt's trading_day: a parity across two different days proves nothing about a reader switch.
